name: targeted_outbound
objective: Run a narrow, problem-led B2B prospecting motion into the approved Platform Reliability Assessment without creating a parallel CRM, guessing contact data, leaking private evidence, or sending bulk outreach.

live_pipeline_baseline.rule: Cold-account research does not create opportunity_id or pipeline_stage. Opportunity identity remains authoritative only after governed assessment intake.

account_selection_criteria: Current public evidence of Kubernetes, platform engineering, SRE, cloud-platform, GitOps, or reliability investment
A plausible operating problem aligned to the Platform Reliability Assessment rather than a generic technology pitch
A current technology/platform decision-owner role can be verified or a precise role target can be identified
No use of inferred private architecture, incidents, customers, outcomes, or unsupported urgency

first_cohort.public_signal: Current Platform Engineering hiring describes highly available platform services, deployment automation, reliability, secure delivery, cost effectiveness, and resolving failure risks at source.

contactability_findings.rule: Use the verified Tayoca domain with explicit send approval; do not substitute public posting, guessed email patterns, or bulk enrichment.

first_wave_drafts.subject: Platform reliability review for SPS
first_wave_drafts.body:
Jamie, I noticed SPS is expanding Platform Engineering around highly available platform services, deployment automation, reliability, and resolving failure risks at source. I run Tayoca's Platform Reliability Assessment, a structured diagnostic for deployment risk, recovery readiness, delivery controls, and operational ownership. Given the scope your platform team is carrying, I thought the framework may be useful as an independent review lens. If it is relevant, I can share the assessment or walk through it with the appropriate platform leader.

allowed_claim_basis: Platform Reliability Assessment scope and CTA
forbidden: claiming knowledge of internal incidents or weaknesses
invented ROI, savings, uptime, compliance, or customer outcomes
mass personalization tokens presented as individual research
outbound_message_contract.first_message_goal: Offer a useful diagnostic conversation or Platform Reliability Assessment, not a hard close.
outbound_message_contract.follow_up_rule: No repeated outreach without a defined cadence and a verified business contact path.

gate.approval_scope: Two approved one-to-one Resend emails to SPS Commerce and MongoDB were sent from the verified Tayoca domain and confirmed delivered by Resend.
